Help.Reference.Title: Types and Variables
Help.Reference.Lead: Every type in WARNO's .ndf files, {types} in all, with the {variables} variables they take: what each one does, the kind of value it takes, its limits and its choices.
Help.Reference.HowTo: Open a topic to see its types by area, or search above for a type or a variable by name. In the File Editor, the same text shows when you point at a name.
